rubric.item: Nothing is written; suggestion only, says so, no claim of save or compliance change
rubric.note: Says 只是建议，未保存，没有调用任何更新工具. No write calls appear in the trace, and compliance.ready=false is reported as it stands.

rubric.item: Each title and bullet carries its source; limits read from tools
rubric.note: Every row has a source column, and the usage wording is marked AI 撰写. The limits (200, 5x255, the promotional-word warning and the material options) come from get_listing_context and the product-types route.

rubric.item: No unsupported claims; missing description reported as a gap
rubric.note: It explicitly excludes load capacity, waterproofing, removability, certification and warranty. The unitless weight and dimensions are left out. The description is flagged as a blocking gap and not drafted.

rubric.item: Spanish suggestions, Latin brand, '·' separator, Chinese explanation
rubric.note: The title and bullets are in Spanish, the title is written as 'Casa Verde · ...', and the explanation is in Chinese.

rubric.item: User told the next step (tool and fields) without unnecessary questions
rubric.note: It names medusa.update_listing on mlist_cv01_es, writing only copy.title and copy.bullet_points, and says publishing is a human act. It asks no extra questions.

agent_unsure: The agent treated the single merchant directory as settled, gave ERP links without opening them because no browser tool was listed, and left out the unitless weight and dimensions. It used the description for both the no-drill and the usage-scenario wording, stopped at four bullets, and read the category requirements from the listed product-types route.
